heard: Gal's son Ophibod came with his brothers, moved in to Shechem and stayed. The leaders put their trust in him, in the shadow of the city gate. Who is Abimelech and who is Shechem, that we should serve him as our king? Is he not the son of Jeroboam, which Nebuchadnezzar's deputy to bring? At the temple of the god of Shechem, Yah spoke his words of open defiance. Serve the men of Hamre, he said, The father of the city and it's alone
